Material does not determine accuracy. Specify an allowable nominal-weight tolerance for the exact range and define the measurement method. Confirm diameter, thickness, center hole, insert fit, grip opening, and symmetry. A premium coating cannot compensate for an out-of-tolerance core.

Replacements must fit existing bars, machines, racks, trays, and storage. For dumbbells, control total length, head diameter, head width, handle length, grip diameter, knurl or contour, and head alignment. For plates, control outside diameter, thickness, center hole or insert, grip openings, and flatness.

Ask how scales are verified, how samples are selected, whether individual or sampled results are recorded, and how out-of-limit plates are handled. Confirm outside diameter, center hole, thickness, and hub fit. If a standard is claimed, request the current standard reference and evidence relevant to the exact product.

Modelos de treino podem usar um inserto menor travado ao corpo. Modelos de competição frequentemente usam um conjunto de cubo de várias peças. Em ambos, o furo central deve encaixar na manga da barra sem folga excessiva e sem dificultar a carga.

A factory that understands free weights can discuss weight tolerance, handle design, rubber smell, surface treatment, plate center hole fit, packaging strength, and container loading. A general trading company may not be able to answer these details clearly.
